test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What was the Government of India Act 1935 based on?

options.text: The principle of a federation and parliamentary system
The acceptance of the idea of a constituent assembly to draft a constitution
The principle of session of the British India provinces
The acceptance of the independence of India

solution:
The correct answer is **The principle of a federation and parliamentary system.**
